sections.title: Gross margin, not profit
sections.text: Gross margin is not profit. Job gross margin = revenue less materials, subcontractors and technician time charged to the job at $68 an hour (wages and all on-costs). Not included: technician time not charged to any job (travel, training, waiting), and overheads (office wages, marketing, vehicles, rent, insurance, IT, depreciation, interest). Profit is what's left after those. Wages include their on-costs: super (12%) and leave as it's earned. No payroll tax: wages are under Queensland's $1.3 million threshold.

sections.text: October is still in progress and wages are paid fortnightly, so a part month can't be bridged: this is September, the latest closed month. September's jobs made $96,230 gross margin (42.7%). Technician time not charged to jobs took $28,417 and overheads $59,580, leaving $8,233 profit before tax (3.7% of revenue). To cover overheads, jobs need a 39.0% gross margin on average.

sections.title: Gross margin, not profit
sections.text: Gross margin is not profit. Job gross margin = revenue less materials, subcontractors and technician time charged to the job at $68 an hour (wages and all on-costs). Not included: technician time not charged to any job (travel, training, waiting), and overheads (office wages, marketing, vehicles, rent, insurance, IT, depreciation, interest). Profit is what's left after those. Wages include their on-costs: super (12%) and leave as it's earned. No payroll tax: wages are under Queensland's $1.3 million threshold.

sections.title: From gross margin to profit
sections.text: September's jobs made $96,230 gross margin (42.7%). Technician time not charged to jobs took $28,417 and overheads $59,580, leaving $8,233 profit before tax (3.7% of revenue). To cover overheads, jobs need a 39.0% gross margin on average.

support.title: Trades: From gross margin to profit, September 2026
support.formula: Gross margin on the work − time not charged − overheads = profit before tax
head: Sep 2026
rows: Technician time charged to jobs (at cost)
Technician time not charged to jobs
Gross margin jobs need just to cover overheads and time not charged
support.note: Ties to the September 2026 P&L (locked). Wages include their on-costs: super (12%) and leave as it's earned. No payroll tax: wages are under Queensland's $1.3 million threshold.

All.shows: Revenue is 26.4% up on the same period last year, year to date ($640,593 against $506,783). Maintenance contracts make the highest gross margin (63.9%); Installations the lowest (37.0%). The business needs 39.0% gross margin just to cover overheads.
All.action: Installations: 37.0% gross margin, 2.0 points over the 35.0% target ($8,257 ahead on $412,100 this financial year to date). Maintenance contracts: 63.9% gross margin, 28.9 points over the 35.0% target ($39,281 ahead on $136,050 this financial year to date).

Maintenance contracts.shows: Maintenance contracts brought in $136,050 this financial year to date, 21.9% on the same period last year (slower than the business as a whole, 26.4%), at a 63.9% gross margin (above the 44.3% overall).
Maintenance contracts.action: Maintenance contracts: 63.9% gross margin, 28.9 points over the 35.0% target ($39,281 ahead on $136,050 this financial year to date).

Installations.shows: Installations brought in $412,100 this financial year to date, 23.8% on the same period last year (slower than the business as a whole, 26.4%), at a 37.0% gross margin (below the 44.3% overall).
Installations.action: Installations: 37.0% gross margin, 2.0 points over the 35.0% target ($8,257 ahead on $412,100 this financial year to date).

Call-outs and repairs.shows: Call-outs and repairs brought in $92,443 this financial year to date, 48.2% on the same period last year (faster than the business as a whole, 26.4%), at a 48.1% gross margin (above the 44.3% overall).
Call-outs and repairs.action: Call-outs and repairs: 48.1% gross margin, 13.1 points over the 35.0% target ($12,124 ahead on $92,443 this financial year to date).

sections.title: Gross margin, not profit
sections.text: Gross margin is not profit. Gross margin = revenue less contractors and consultant time charged to the work at $60 an hour (wages and all on-costs). Not included: consultant time not charged to clients, and overheads (management and admin wages, marketing, rent, IT, insurance, travel, depreciation, interest). Profit is what's left after those. Wages include their on-costs: super (12%) and leave as it's earned. No payroll tax: wages are under Queensland's $1.3 million threshold.

sections.title: Gross margin, not profit
sections.text: Gross margin is not profit. Job gross margin = revenue less materials, subcontractors and technician time charged to the job at $68 an hour (wages and all on-costs). Not included: technician time not charged to any job (travel, training, waiting), and overheads (office wages, marketing, vehicles, rent, insurance, IT, depreciation, interest). Profit is what's left after those. Wages include their on-costs: super (12%) and leave as it's earned. No payroll tax: wages are under Queensland's $1.3 million threshold.

sections.title: From gross margin to profit
sections.text: July's jobs made $93,486 gross margin (43.4%). Technician time not charged to jobs took $26,391 and overheads $59,440, leaving $7,655 profit before tax (3.6% of revenue). To cover overheads, jobs need a 39.8% gross margin on average.

support.title: Trades: From gross margin to profit, July 2026
support.formula: Gross margin on the work − time not charged − overheads = profit before tax
head: Jul 2026
rows: Technician time charged to jobs (at cost)
Technician time not charged to jobs
Gross margin jobs need just to cover overheads and time not charged
support.note: Ties to the July 2026 P&L (locked). Wages include their on-costs: super (12%) and leave as it's earned. No payroll tax: wages are under Queensland's $1.3 million threshold.

All.shows: Revenue is 3.4% up on the same period last year, year to date ($215,610 against $208,588). Maintenance contracts make the highest gross margin (63.9%); Installations the lowest (36.0%). The business needs 39.8% gross margin just to cover overheads.
All.action: Installations: 36.0% gross margin, 1.0 points over the 35.0% target ($1,430 ahead on $143,000 this financial year to date). Maintenance contracts: 63.9% gross margin, 28.9 points over the 35.0% target ($13,094 ahead on $45,350 this financial year to date).

Maintenance contracts.shows: Maintenance contracts brought in $45,350 this financial year to date, 21.9% on the same period last year (faster than the business as a whole, 3.4%), at a 63.9% gross margin (above the 43.4% overall).
Maintenance contracts.action: Maintenance contracts: 63.9% gross margin, 28.9 points over the 35.0% target ($13,094 ahead on $45,350 this financial year to date).

Installations.shows: Installations brought in $143,000 this financial year to date, (6.0%) on the same period last year (slower than the business as a whole, 3.4%), at a 36.0% gross margin (below the 43.4% overall).
Installations.action: Installations: 36.0% gross margin, 1.0 points over the 35.0% target ($1,430 ahead on $143,000 this financial year to date).

Call-outs and repairs.shows: Call-outs and repairs brought in $27,260 this financial year to date, 41.3% on the same period last year (faster than the business as a whole, 3.4%), at a 47.8% gross margin (above the 43.4% overall).
Call-outs and repairs.action: Call-outs and repairs: 47.8% gross margin, 12.8 points over the 35.0% target ($3,499 ahead on $27,260 this financial year to date).

sections.title: Gross margin, not profit
sections.text: Gross margin is not profit. Gross margin = revenue less contractors and consultant time charged to the work at $60 an hour (wages and all on-costs). Not included: consultant time not charged to clients, and overheads (management and admin wages, marketing, rent, IT, insurance, travel, depreciation, interest). Profit is what's left after those. Wages include their on-costs: super (12%) and leave as it's earned. No payroll tax: wages are under Queensland's $1.3 million threshold.

sections.title: Gross margin, not profit
sections.text: Gross margin is not profit. Job gross margin = revenue less materials, subcontractors and technician time charged to the job at $68 an hour (wages and all on-costs). Not included: technician time not charged to any job (travel, training, waiting), and overheads (office wages, marketing, vehicles, rent, insurance, IT, depreciation, interest). Profit is what's left after those. Wages include their on-costs: super (12%) and leave as it's earned. No payroll tax: wages are under Queensland's $1.3 million threshold.

sections.title: Gross margin, not profit
sections.text: Gross margin is not profit. Gross margin = revenue less contractors and consultant time charged to the work at $60 an hour (wages and all on-costs). Not included: consultant time not charged to clients, and overheads (management and admin wages, marketing, rent, IT, insurance, travel, depreciation, interest). Profit is what's left after those. Wages include their on-costs: super (12%) and leave as it's earned. No payroll tax: wages are under Queensland's $1.3 million threshold.

sections.title: Gross margin, not profit
sections.text: Gross margin is not profit. Job gross margin = revenue less materials, subcontractors and technician time charged to the job at $68 an hour (wages and all on-costs). Not included: technician time not charged to any job (travel, training, waiting), and overheads (office wages, marketing, vehicles, rent, insurance, IT, depreciation, interest). Profit is what's left after those. Wages include their on-costs: super (12%) and leave as it's earned. No payroll tax: wages are under Queensland's $1.3 million threshold.

sections.title: Gross margin, not profit
sections.text: Gross margin is not profit. Gross margin = revenue less contractors and consultant time charged to the work at $60 an hour (wages and all on-costs). Not included: consultant time not charged to clients, and overheads (management and admin wages, marketing, rent, IT, insurance, travel, depreciation, interest). Profit is what's left after those. sections.title: Gross margin, not profit
sections.text: Gross margin is not profit. Job gross margin = revenue less materials, subcontractors and technician time charged to the job at $68 an hour (wages and all on-costs). Not included: technician time not charged to any job (travel, training, waiting), and overheads (office wages, marketing, vehicles, rent, insurance, IT, depreciation, interest). Profit is what's left after those. Wages include their on-costs: super (12%) and leave as it's earned. No payroll tax: wages are under Queensland's $1.3 million threshold.
